text:
Jordan: Quick heads-up — 10:00 all-hands in 45. Small agenda change: Exec Q&A will move to the end to give Eng 5 extra mins for the runtime demo.
Priya: Got it. AV team — can we shorten the demo deck to 8 slides? Need to keep time for live q's. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sam: I can cut one demo slide. Also what's the plan for the Q&A queue? Will we do live mic + Slack questions?
Leah: Let's do live mics for on-site folks, Slack thread for remote. I'll triage Slack Qs and feed them to the stage. Volunteer for handoff.
Victor: Recorder noticed an intermittent drop last month. Ops, can we confirm recorder health? RecorderBot, any alerts?
RecorderBot: recording_service: started -> session_id=ah-2024-05-24-10
RecorderBot: error -> disk_io_timeout on recorder-node-3 (elapsed=12s). Fallback recommended.
ops-bot: Starting failover plan: move recording to fallback-instance-2, restart encoder. ETA ~90s.
Priya: If fallback is used, captions might be lost. Is automated captions tied to primary recorder?
Victor: Yes — captions pipeline is only on primary. If we failover we'll need captions from cloud ASR as backup.
Jordan: OK prioritize continuous recording over captions. Leah, after handoff, can you ping Engineering to clip any missing sections for internal use?
Leah: Yup. I'll mark timestamps in the Slack thread.
Sam: Ops — what's the command to flip recorder? Putting it here to run when ready:
```
ssh ops@recorder-node-3
sudo systemctl stop recorder
ssh ops@fallback-instance-2
sudo systemctl start recorder
```
Priya: @ops-bot once failover completes please post a short status update and start a 1-min mic check for presenters.
ops-bot: failover: initiated -> stopping recorder on recorder-node-3
ops-bot: failover: complete -> recorder running on fallback-instance-2, session_id=ah-2024-05-24-10-b
RecorderBot: recording_service: resumed -> session_id=ah-2024-05-24-10-b
Victor: Confirmed stream is live, encoder latency +50ms vs baseline. Video looks good.
Jordan: Thanks folks. Remind presenters to mute when not speaking. We'll take Q&A from Slack first 10 mins then open mics.
Leah: Logging Qs now. First remote Q from @maria: "Will Redwood open more APAC regions this year?"
Jordan: Short answer: yes — planning two new regions H2. We'll cover in roadmap slide and follow up with a doc.
Sam: Also note — runtime demo will show continuous batching improvements and a perf chart. Cutting 2 slides as requested.
Priya: Ready for mic check in ~2 mins. @presenters gather near stage.
Leah: I'll post the final approximate times in a sec. :white_check_mark:
